column1: # ROG5 userspace install manifest, read by scripts/device/rog5-install-userspace.
# Paths match the reference phone (checked read-only against it on 2026-09-30).
# Columns are separated by one or more tabs:
#   file   SOURCE  TARGET  MODE   always installed (the repository owns it)
#   conf   SOURCE  TARGET  MODE   installed only when TARGET is absent (a local
#   build  SOURCE  TARGET  MODE   C helper compiled with cc (pkg-config libdrm)
#   enable system|user UNIT       enabled with systemctl --root
#   user-file SOURCE  RELATIVE  MODE   into the phone user's home, owned by it
# SOURCE is relative to the repository root. The boot bundle, not this list,
# provides the platform, Wi-Fi, update and trial units (they live in /run).
# Hostname and the Bluetooth/GNOME device name
# Phone shell (Phosh) and GNOME desktop mode
# Remote desktop (headless Sway and the wayvnc phone mirror, loopback only)
# Power: sleep policy, charge limit and bypass, performance mode, bad-memory retirement
# USB: module autoload, replug recovery, runtime PM, bottom port, storage
# Network, firewall, hotspot, SSH, health endpoint
# Steam (native arm64 client, FEX guest root, 8-bit Turnip for the guest)
# Services enabled on the reference phone (tailscaled is optional: enable it
# yourself after `pacman -S tailscale`; rog5-healthd serves :8787, which the
# firewall only admits on USB and Tailscale)
